title: Orthopaedic Surgeon
qualification: MBBS, MS Orthopaedics, Fellowship in Sports Medicine & Joint Replacement
heroIntro: Evidence-led orthopaedic care with clear guidance at every step—from diagnosis to recovery.
aboutLead: Dr. Parikshit Patil is an orthopaedic surgeon with focused training in sports medicine, arthroscopy, trauma care and joint replacement.
aboutDetail: His clinical experience across hospitals in Mumbai, Ranchi, Jamshedpur and Pune is complemented by a strong interest in medical education and research. He believes patients make better decisions when their diagnosis and treatment choices are explained clearly.

services.title: Fracture & Trauma Care
services.description: Assessment and management of fractures and orthopaedic injuries, including emergency stabilization and surgical treatment where appropriate.

services.title: Sports Injuries
services.description: Evaluation and treatment planning for ligament, tendon, cartilage and activity-related injuries, with the goal of a safe return to movement.

services.title: Knee Arthroscopy
services.description: Minimally invasive keyhole procedures for selected knee conditions, including ligament and meniscus injuries.

services.title: Shoulder Arthroscopy
services.description: Specialist assessment and keyhole treatment options for selected shoulder pain, instability and tendon injuries.

services.title: Joint Replacement
services.description: Evaluation and surgical care for advanced joint disease when pain and reduced mobility continue despite appropriate non-surgical treatment.

services.title: Joint Preservation
services.description: Treatment strategies designed to protect the natural joint, improve function and delay more extensive surgery when possible.

experience.institution: Tata Main Hospital & Manipal Tata Medical College, Jamshedpur
Shree Jagannath Hospital & Research Centre, Ranchi
Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital, Mumbai

academicCopy: Dr. Patil has contributed to undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, clinical skills assessment and competency-based medical education, alongside presentations and research in trauma, sports injuries and spine care.
